neighbours.label: A subject pronoun right after a fronted object ('What you sow, you reap', 'These they lost'); the same content in normal word order stays quiet
fire: What little he earned, he spent on books.
Whatever she cooked, we ate without complaint.
Those letters I burned long before the trial.
The gold coins they hid beneath the chapel floor.
What the teacher says, the pupils repeat, and what she writes, they copy.
His first novel I liked; his second I hated.
Most of the silver he sold to a dealer in Rome.
The smaller boxes we stacked near the door.
